name: Call of Water

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you cross the sea from the Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor, sailing from Menethil Harbor to Auberdine. From there, you reach Astranaar, a Night Elf settlement.
As a Night Elf, you are sent to gather water from the pure lake beside Astranaar, in the heartlands of the Kaldorei in Ashenvale. Ancient ruins still lie undisturbed there.

faq.answer: You carry an empty waterskin into Ashenvale's ancient forest to gather pure water from the lake beside Astranaar. The sample may be enchanted, and you return it to the giver.
faq.q: What is the quest Call of Water?

faq.answer: Gather water from the lake beside Astranaar, deep in Ashenvale. It remains uncorrupted, and ancient sunken ruins lie beneath its surface.
faq.q: Where do I collect the water for this quest?

faq.answer: Cross the sea by boat from Menethil Harbor to Auberdine. The boat stops at Southshore along the way. From Auberdine on the Darkshore coast, travel south through Ashenvale's deep woods to Astranaar.
faq.q: How do I travel to Ashenvale for this quest?

faq.answer: The lake beside Astranaar holds water untouched by corruption. Sunken stone ruins suggest an ancient era of elven civilization and give the water its pure, potentially enchanted qualities.
faq.q: What makes the water at Astranaar special?

faq.answer: Norric is waiting for you after you gather the final liquid sample. The giver collects the pure Ashenvale water before sending you back to Norric.
Ashenvale is an ancient, dense forest full of perils. The giver warns you to stay alert beneath its green canopy, where watchful eyes do not blink.
faq.q: What dangers should I expect in Ashenvale?

sections.body: You are sent to fill a waterskin with Ashenvale's uncorrupted water. Astranaar is a haven beside the lake, whose ancient waters lap against sunken ruins. This is the last liquid sample the giver needs before sending you on to Norric.
sections.title: The Search for Pure Water

sections.body: To reach Ashenvale from the Eastern Kingdoms, cross the sea by ship from Menethil Harbor toward Auberdine. The ship puts in at Southshore along the way. From Auberdine's docks, follow the road inland beneath Ashenvale's green boughs. Stay alert among the watchful shadows of the trees.
sections.title: The Road to Astranaar

summary: In Ashenvale, you gather pure water from the lake beside Astranaar. It is the last sample you need before returning to Norric.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Water
